easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
